text: Frequently Asked Questions on ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship Q. No. 1: What are the eligibility criteria of awarding ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: Securing admission in Post Graduate programme in any non-domicile state. Q. No. 2: Who is eligible to get ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: National Talent Scholarship (NTS) of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research is available to a student pursuing Master degree programme admitted through All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) in the Agricultural University located outside of his State of domicile. Q. No. 3: What is the amount and duration of ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: NTS-PG is awarded @ Rs.5000/- per month to PG students for entire duration of degree programme subject to minimum qualifying CGPA. Q. No. 4: Is there any evaluation process for continuation of ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: The continuation of the ICAR NTS-PG scholarship is subject to good conduct, punctuality and minimum prescribed performance [OGPA/CGPA of minimum 7.00 OUT of 10.00 (6.50/10.00 for SC/ST)]. Q. No. 5: Are students admitted in State Agricultural Universities through their entrance test eligible for ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: No. Students admitted through All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) under ICAR All India Quota (AIQ) seats in the Agricultural Universities under ICAR-AU System are only eligible. Q. No. 6: How many scholarships are awarded in a year? Answer: All those candidates satisfying the condition of non -domicile criteria in their admission are eligible. Q. No. 7: Do I have to apply separately for ICAR NTS-PG Scholarship? Answer: No. Candidates who appeared and admitted through All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) under ICAR AIQ Seats are automatically eligible for the said scholarship. Q. No. 8: What documents are required to be uploaded on NSP for release of the scholarship? Answer: Award letter issued by the ICAR may be required.
